Build, preview, and ship web applications at the edge

Every Git push builds in an isolated container and publishes an immutable preview URL with production-equivalent TLS, routing rules, and environment bindings. Reviewers leave inline comments pinned to DOM nodes and inspect Core Web Vitals before merging pull requests into the main branch.

Incremental static regeneration and zero-downtime rollbacks

Cache dynamic responses at regional PoPs and revalidate individual cache tags on demand via webhook or server action without rebuilding the entire site. Content updates propagate globally in under 300ms while stale-while-revalidate headers keep tail latency flat during traffic spikes.

Because build artifacts are content-addressed and retained in object storage, rolling back a broken release takes a single atomic pointer swap in the routing table with zero cold-start penalty or DNS propagation delay.
